replacements.instruction: Table 2 caption の citation と reader takeaway を維持したまま、70-word caption guard に収めるため列挙を簡潔化する。表本体は変えない。
replacements.before: \caption{Operational comparison of the evaluated writing systems. \condStaged\ follows fixed planning--drafting--revision stages~\citep{yang2022re3,wan2025cognitive}; \condTaskPlanning\ follows WriteHERE-style task planning~\citep{xiong2025beyond}. The first four rows expose the central difference in what advances next: a whole document, a fixed stage, a task node, or a writing process. $X$ is the task input; $D_t$, $G_t$, and $H_t$ are draft, goals, and process history; $T_t$ is the task graph. The remaining rows modify \condAgenticCogWriter; \condSingleContext\ was added post-hoc.}
replacements.after: \caption{Operational comparison of the evaluated writing systems. \condStaged\ follows fixed planning--drafting--revision stages~\citep{yang2022re3,wan2025cognitive}; \condTaskPlanning\ follows WriteHERE-style task planning~\citep{xiong2025beyond}. The first four rows expose the central difference in what advances next: document, stage, task node, or writing process. $X$ is the task input; $D_t$, $G_t$, and $H_t$ are draft, goals, and process history; $T_t$ is the task graph. The remaining rows modify \condAgenticCogWriter; \condSingleContext\ was added post-hoc.}
